title: 8-Mode Ring Long-Horizon Endurance Extension (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `ring_extension` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Continues the candidate's converged `ring_hold` state without resetting or re-annealing to test whether all 8 modes and high sample quality (hq >= 0.90) persist over an extended training horizon.
failure_mode: Slow prior drift, step-size decay artifacts, or undamped minimax cycles cause delayed mode collapse hundreds of updates after initial convergence.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `ring_extension` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
